short_goal: Create a high-energy, 15-25s YouTube Short in vertical format for 'Sigma Vibes'.
instructions_for_model: Produce JSON only. Create 3-4 scenes: hook, 1-2 tips (each short), and CTA. Each scene needs: title (short hook line), subtitle (one-line supporting text), voice_text (what should be spoken), and duration_seconds (integer). Make them punchy, contrarian and 'Sigma' in tone. Output strictly valid JSON with top-level key 'scenes' array and 'total_duration'.
